feeding_claim.verbatim: All our animals are grass fed & pasture raised.

notes: Not the state Sweet Grown Alabama program; a private farm with a similar name. Contact page gives Athens, AL 35611; About page says the 22-acre farm is in Tanner, AL. Products page says steers live their entire life on pasture, but no finishing statement, so kept grass-fed. Poultry and laying hens get supplemental non-GMO grain. Orders through Barn2Door store (not read); delivers to Athens and Madison zip codes. No bulk shares, pickup, markets or phone found.
